title: Vachengeti veMugove Wakavanzika
intro: Munyika yakasvibira, boka revanhu rakaronga zano rakavanzika murima. Vaiva nechinangwa chimwe chete, asi chinangwa chavo chakanga chisina kururama. Vaisaziva kuti kushanduka kwaMwari kwakavamirira pavakarara.
clues: Takaita chitsidzo chakasimba, tichifunga kuti hurongwa hwedu hwaive husina kana chahwakakanganisa.
Taida kubuda nguva isati yakwana, vamwe vasati vatombotanga kushamisika.
Patakasvika kwataienda, takaiwana isina chinhu uye isina chinhu, saka takafunga kuti takanga takarasika.
Takabva taona kuti ndiyo yaive nzvimbo yedu zvechokwadi, uye takachema nekusuwa, tichipomerana mhosva yekurasikirwa kwedu.
Takanga tapika mangwanani iwayo kuti hatizobvumidze varombo kuti vagovere goho redu, asi chirango chaAllah chakatiwira patakanga takarara, zvikaita kuti bindu redu rive dongo.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
